name: verify
description: Is it right, and does it work? Review by reading: code-sweep runs twelve parallel reviewers (or a light six-aspect pass) with the code-reviewer agent; lenses for AI debt, complexity (14 metrics on TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Rust and GDScript), blast radius, API design and Python anti-patterns; code-review-excellence and receiving-code-review for both sides of a review. Prove by running: verify-feature, verify-this, santa-method, human-gate and benchmark-checklist; a project-local verification skill; harnesses for CLI, browser, iOS Simulator and Windows desktop; test suites with e2e-harness, Playwright, React Testing Library, Bats and k6, and test-audit to prune them; exploratory dogfood, adversarial UX, click-path and web-quality audits. Vendored skills are credited in NOTICE.md.
